General.Description:
Marine archaeologist Dr. Cass Devereux has spent nine years cracking a cipher distributed across the spines of three seventeenth-century books. Now she has the key, the map, and a destination in the Caribbean — and a shipping magnate's private security force three days behind her.

Rosa Almeida's sun-drenched adaptation of Eliza Thornton's treasure-hunt novel is the kind of unpretentious adventure movie that major studios rarely greenlight and audiences consistently love when they find it. Cara Donahue brings enormous charm and physical credibility to the role of Cass, a woman who is brilliant, perpetually underfunded, and absolutely refuses to let either of those facts slow her down. The film's third act — a night dive into a seventeenth-century wreck site while the security team closes in above — is a set piece of real ingenuity.

Funny, fast, and splendidly entertaining.
